reason: Heuristic keys share the provider-id identifier grammar (lowercase-start, then lowercase/digit/dot/underscore/hyphen only); "Prompt" fails it in Go because of the capital P. The Rust validator previously reused the generic version-token grammar (which allows uppercase) for this field, silently accepting it; since fixed (endpoint/src/detection.rs) to use the same strict identifier grammar as Go for provider ids and heuristic keys.
